programs.title: Wild Tales from the Farm
programs.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn’s final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: Chasing the Rains
programs.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programs.title: Chasing the Rains
programs.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programs.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride
programs.desc: Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP’s lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory.

director: Jo Robinson: Series Producer, Jules Braatvedt: On-Screen DP & Narrator
